title: Small feature with tests: isPalindrome
goal: Add src/palindrome.ts exporting isPalindrome(s), ignoring case and non-alphanumeric characters, with its own tests/palindrome.test.ts.
prompt: Add a new file src/palindrome.ts that exports `isPalindrome(s: string): boolean`, returning true when `s` reads the same forwards and backwards once case and non-alphanumeric characters are ignored (so "A man a plan a canal Panama" is a palindrome). Add tests/palindrome.test.ts with at least a true case, a false case, and the empty string. `npm test` must pass.
